output.sql:
SELECT p.category,
       ROUND(SUM(ol.net_amount), 2) AS net_revenue,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ol.net_amount) DESC) AS revenue_rank
FROM marts.fct_order_lines ol
JOIN marts.fct_orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
JOIN marts.dim_products p ON p.product_id = ol.product_id
WHERE o.is_revenue
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY net_revenue DESC;
output.explanation: This query ranks the product categories by net revenue for the whole period, 2024-01-01 to 2025-12-31, highest first. It adds up the net amount of each order line and groups the totals by product category. Following the warehouse definition of revenue, it only counts lines from completed orders (is_revenue is true). Cancelled, returned and open orders are left out, and so are shipping fees. Revenue is after line discounts and rounded to 2 decimals. If two categories have exactly the same total, they get the same rank.
